decisions.reason: As an award-winning flagship stollen that is very close to the firm's core confectionery knowledge, it gives strong positive feedback that the bakery can readily exploit and improve with existing capabilities.

This rye bread variant fits the firm's established baking know-how and its survival after other new breads were removed suggests the firm has learned enough from early market response to justify continuing it.

Marzipan Christmas stollen is closely related to the firm's traditional seasonal strengths, so even without explicit awards it is a product the firm can support and refine with its existing recipes, skills, and holiday demand knowledge.
